Had a lot of fun tinkering with fusion360 this session, finally tried out the realistic graphics thing which was really cool although it did eat up a lot of my computers memory. This is also one of my first times using fusion professionally (I usually use tinkercad for all my cad projects) so it was quite challenging figuring out how to do this and that, but after a few tutorials by my brother and youtube I got hang of most of the basic controls.
